WELCOME_ATTRACT.text: Welcome. Please step forward to begin voting.

SELECT_LANGUAGE.text: Please choose your language. Point at your language and hold.

FACE_AUTH_INSTRUCTIONS.text: Please look at the camera and blink naturally.

FACE_AUTH_LIVENESS_RETRY.text: We could not confirm you are present. Please look at the camera and blink again.

FACE_AUTH_FAIL.text: We could not recognize you. Please see a registration official.

FACE_AUTH_AMBIGUOUS.text: We could not confirm your identity with confidence. Please see an official for assistance.

ALREADY_VOTED.text: Our records show you have already voted. Thank you.

FACE_AUTH_SUCCESS.text: Identity confirmed. Let's begin your ballot.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_PRESIDENT.text: Point at the party you choose for President, and hold.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_GOVERNOR.text: Point at the party you choose for Governor, and hold.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_SENATE.text: Point at the party you choose for Senator, and hold.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_HOR.text: Point at the party you choose for House of Representatives, and hold.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_SHA.text: Point at the party you choose for State House of Assembly, and hold.

SELECTION_CONFIRM_PROMPT.text: Hold again to confirm, or point at change to pick a different party.

REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS.text: Here is your ballot. Review your choices before submitting.

REVIEW_EDIT_PROMPT.text: Point at any office to change your choice.

SUBMIT_CONFIRM_PROMPT.text: Hold submit to cast your ballot. This cannot be undone.

SUBMIT_SUCCESS.text: Your ballot has been cast successfully.

SUBMIT_FAILED_RETRY.text: Something went wrong submitting your ballot. Please hold retry.

THANK_YOU.text: Thank you for voting. Please step away for the next voter.

TIMEOUT_WARNING.text: Are you still there? This session will end soon.

ERROR_GENERIC.text: Something went wrong. An official has been notified.
